action_inputs.description: When True (default), set rotationToLatestKeyVersionEnabled on the DES so disks follow new versions of the per-VM key automatically (within about an hour, no reboot).
action_inputs.label: Azure CMK Auto Key Rotation
action_inputs.name: azure_cmk_auto_key_rotation

action_inputs.description: Appended to the VM name to form the Disk Encryption Set name, e.g. -DES gives <vm>-DES. Characters outside a-z A-Z 0-9 _ - are replaced with a hyphen.
action_inputs.label: Azure CMK DES Name Suffix
action_inputs.name: azure_cmk_des_suffix

action_inputs.description: When True (default), also enable encryption at host on the VM while it is deallocated. Requires the Microsoft.Compute/EncryptionAtHost feature registered on the subscription and a supported VM size; a failure here is reported as WARNING, the disks stay CMK-encrypted and the VM is restarted.
action_inputs.label: Azure CMK Enable Encryption At Host
action_inputs.name: azure_cmk_encryption_at_host

action_inputs.description: Disk Encryption Set encryptionType: EncryptionAtRestWithCustomerKey (default) or EncryptionAtRestWithPlatformAndCustomerKeys (double encryption at rest; not supported on Ultra / Premium SSD v2 disks).
action_inputs.label: Azure CMK Encryption Type
action_inputs.name: azure_cmk_encryption_type

action_inputs.description: Number of days from creation until the per-VM Key Vault key expires (KeyAttributes.exp). Must be 1-89: keys are required to expire in less than 90 days. Default 89. Re-runs that reuse an existing key keep that key's original expiry.
action_inputs.label: Azure CMK Key Expiration (Days)
action_inputs.name: azure_cmk_key_expiration_days

action_inputs.description: RSA key size in bits: 2048, 3072 or 4096 (the only sizes Azure Disk Storage supports). Default 2048.
action_inputs.label: Azure CMK Key Size
action_inputs.name: azure_cmk_key_size

action_inputs.description: Appended to the VM name to form the Key Vault key name, e.g. -key gives <vm>-key. Characters outside a-z A-Z 0-9 - are replaced with a hyphen.
action_inputs.label: Azure CMK Key Name Suffix
action_inputs.name: azure_cmk_key_suffix

action_inputs.description: Key Vault key type for the per-VM key: RSA (software) or RSA-HSM (requires a premium-tier vault). Default RSA.
action_inputs.label: Azure CMK Key Type
action_inputs.name: azure_cmk_key_type

action_inputs.description: ARM resource ID of the Key Vault holding per-VM disk-encryption keys (/subscriptions/.../providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<name>). Must have soft delete AND purge protection enabled and be in the same region as the VM (a different subscription is allowed; Managed HSM is not). A parameter of the same name on the Environment/Group overrides this default per server.
action_inputs.label: Azure CMK Key Vault (Resource ID)
action_inputs.name: azure_cmk_key_vault_id

action_inputs.description: Optional. ARM resource ID of an existing user-assigned managed identity (/subscriptions/.../providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/<name>). When set, each per-VM Disk Encryption Set is created with this identity instead of a system-assigned one and the per-DES key-access grant is skipped; the identity must already hold Get/Wrap Key/Unwrap Key (role Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User, or an access policy) on the Key Vault. Leave empty for the default system-assigned identity + per-DES grant.
action_inputs.label: Azure CMK User-Assigned Identity (Resource ID)
action_inputs.name: azure_cmk_user_assigned_identity_id

description: Creates a per-VM Key Vault key and disk encryption set and re-encrypts a provisioned Azure VM's disks with it.
name: Azure CMK - Per-VM Disk Encryption Set
